commands: echo '=== FIXING CASE MISMATCH IN URL ==='
echo '--- Get the correct ALB URL dynamically ---'
echo '--- Update config.php with correct case ---'
echo '--- Update database with correct case ---'
DB_SECRET_ARN=$(aws secretsmanager list-secrets --region "$REGION" --query "SecretList[?contains(Name, 'Moodle') || contains(Name, 'Db')].ARN" --output text | head -1)
echo 'Updating database wwwroot with correct case...'

mysql -h "$DB_ENDPOINT" -u "$DB_USER" -p"$DB_PASS" -D moodle -e "UPDATE mdl_config SET value='$CORRECT_ALB_URL' WHERE name='wwwroot';" 2>/dev/null && echo 'Database updated successfully' || echo 'Could not update database'
mysql -h "$DB_ENDPOINT" -u "$DB_USER" -p"$DB_PASS" -D moodle -e "SELECT name, value FROM mdl_config WHERE name='wwwroot';" 2>/dev/null || echo 'Could not verify database'
echo 'Testing with follow redirects (should not loop):'
timeout 10 curl -sL http://localhost/ | head -10 || echo 'Request timed out or completed'
curl -sI http://localhost/ | grep -i location || echo 'No location header'
